alara_input_recipe.flux: flux f1 <file> 1.0 0 default; file lists group fluxes in library (descending) order
alara_input_recipe.geometry: rectangular + volumes 1.0 z1 (point geometry has zero volume)
alara_input_recipe.isotope_identity: text rows are anonymous (ALARA 2.9.2 symbol() display defect); identity is recovered from alara.dmp KZAs aligned by sorted-kza order + t_1/2 cross-check
alara_input_recipe.mixture: element <sym> <1/rho_element> <wt_fraction> per element -> exact 1 g, natural isotopic ratios from elelib
alara_input_recipe.output: zone; units Bq g; specific_activity number_density total_heat photon_source(24g)
alara_input_recipe.schedule: schedule s / <irr_s> s f1 pulse_once 0 s; pulsehistory 1 0 s
alara_input_recipe.truncation: 1e-15 for all cases (uniform solver control; resolves daughters at the campaign flux ~1e10 n/cm2/s; the IRDFF spectrum is normalized to the fns_709 total so this single tolerance captures equivalent chain depth for every case)

decision_fields.executability: per-case per-leg status (executable | contract_gap) with missing-isotope lists; G3 verdict reads the census
decision_fields.identical_data_outcome: all-gap census is itself the measured executability result; no numeric comparison exists
decision_fields.product_plus_data_responses: per-case per-time response pairs; differences reported against frozen response list

actinv_fendl_silent_bulk.rationale: P26b G1 established ACTINV can run on the FENDL artifact with Fe-57 silently missing (incomplete parent partition -> reduced answer, not an error). One diagnostic run documents this behavior; it is NOT a leg measurement and lives in the diagnostic evidence partition.

isotope_expansion.note: ACTINV expands elements via the abundance table (e.g. ta -> {Ta-180m, Ta-181}); ALARA expands via myElelib (ta -> {Ta-181} only).  Each arm is checked against its own required set.

known_precedent_defects.alara_292_symbol_display: isotope names print as '-A' with the element symbol blank in this build (verified on stock sample3); identity is recovered via alara.dmp KZA alignment, cross-checked by t_1/2 and lambda*N vs printed activity.
known_precedent_defects.p26_fns_spectrum_reversed: the frozen P26 campaign specs wrote the example's descending flux_per_group without descending:true; ACTINV treated it as ascending.  P26b applies spectra correctly: descending:true for fns_709 specs, ascending collapse for irdff_sp_mat9861_709 (no flag), descending order for ALARA flux files.  Frozen P26 artifacts are not modified; this is recorded here as the precedent caveat.

identical_data.meaning: both tools consume the same FENDL-3.2c evaluations; pass/fail on frozen tolerances

product_plus_data.meaning: each tool with its standard data; differences reported, never a solver verdict

actinv_shipped_tendl2025.note: v1.1.0 catalog also ships the unpatched v1.0.0 artifact (id tendl-2025-neutron-709g, sha256 ec4c72bf598dc8ad3d533d9cfafdcf493e2d1f949a3e4db6251495659b68cc44); it covers all 36 contract isotopes and is recorded for provenance only.

draft_targets_under_test.hands_on: 50% median hands-on reduction — no recorded baseline; remains undetermined

measurement_rules.headroom_ratio: comparator_complete_wall_time / actinv_complete_wall_time on the complete campaign; reportable only where equivalent-output holds (identical_data) or as labeled product_plus_data
measurement_rules.tmpdir: disk-backed, target/preflight-tmp inside the bounded scope
measurement_rules.wall_time_scope: complete path: input parse + data load + collapse + solve + requested outputs

response_semantics.photon_source_per_group_24: fispact-24 group totals: ALARA photsrc.out TOTAL rows vs ACTINV photon_source.groups[].photons_s_g
response_semantics.product_atoms_per_g: like-for-like populated-products inventory: ACTINV reports total_atoms_per_g directly; ALARA is computed as the sum over isotope rows whose pre-irrad column is zero (products only)
response_semantics.total_atoms_per_g: as reported by each tool: ALARA's number-density total counts every atom including the unburned bulk; ACTINV's counts populated (non-initial) states only - NOT like-for-like

derivation.rule: overlap-conserving histogram collapse onto the fispact-709 boundaries carried as 'bounds' in the pinned NPZ

irdff_sp_mat9861_709.normalization: frozen overlap-conserving collapse preserves shape (raw sum ~= 1); scaled by 11166128698.1 to the fns_709 total flux 11166502554.2 n/cm2/s so both spectra run at matched total flux and ALARA's 1e-15 truncation resolves equivalent chain depth (at unit flux the products fall below any tractable truncation tolerance)
irdff_sp_mat9861_709.order: ascending after collapse; reversed to descending for the ALARA flux file

product_plus_data.note: no pass bound; differences reported and labeled
